conviction_note: Close to a non-result. The Q2 call already told the market that Q3 payoffs could pass $1bn, that management had stopped forecasting loan growth, and that Q2 carried roughly $5m of one-off fee and accretion income. Consensus EPS of $0.63, against Q2's $0.64, already reflects that. The small positives are the 2026-09-16 Fed hike, which management called 'net positive', and the buyback promise. Findings sum to +0.2 and the scaled number is +0.11 (p_up 52 x abs 2.8). The two measurements agree in sign, and both are small because the bar has only one source.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS $0.63 and revenue $294.0m, from https://www.benzinga.com/quote/HOMB/earnings-forecasts (accessed 2026-10-14). Only one estimate source was found. A Benzinga headline citing $0.64 could not be verified, and the company gives no EPS guide. Every finding is therefore capped small. The bar sits about 1c below Q2's adjusted $0.64 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001331520/000133152026000106/homb063026earningsrelease.htm).
positioning_check: Short interest was 9,907,152 shares at the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement, about 5.0% of 200.05m shares outstanding, with 5.98 days to cover. It jumped from 8.53m on 09-15 and peaked at 11.0m on 06-30 (https://equibles.com/stocks/homb/shortinterest, read 2026-10-14). That is elevated but not crowded. The baseline has no options (empty_chain) and so no skew. The stock is -5.21% over 20 days and -10.45% from its 52-week high.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 non-interest income and NII held about $5m+ of items management said may not recur: a $2.4m gain on SBIC equity investments, a BOLI gain, $0.9m of purchase-accounting accretion from early payoffs, and $1.7m of event interest income. That is roughly $0.02 per share pre-tax, a headwind to Q3 against Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: HOMB trades on the reported quarter. After the Q2 beat with record revenue it rose +4.78% (baseline, 2026-07-15), and after the softer Q1 it fell -3.36% (2026-04-15).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: consensus at $0.63 is 1c below Q2. If the street had fully removed the one-offs plus the payoff drag, the bar would be lower still, but revenue consensus of $294.0m is almost flat on Q2's $295.1m.
findings.independence: The Q2 8-K release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001331520/000133152026000106/homb063026earningsrelease.htm) puts event interest income at $1.7m (4bp of NIM) and accretion at $3.6m against $1.1m in Q1. That is the same company's disclosure in another document.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management said Q3 payoffs 'appeared high' and the gap was 'higher now than 90 days ago', with Q2 payoffs a little over $1bn and Q3 'could be there'. Allison said the bank will no longer forecast loan growth. Average earning assets therefore probably shrank organically in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 management had guided toward a ~$600m loan decline and delivered +$26m. The stock rose +4.78%. On this line the company tends to under-promise.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, because the warning came on the public call and the revenue consensus is flat. It stays filed because the sign is open: a repeat of Q2's over-delivery against a conservative warning would be a positive surprise. Shrunk to -0.1 for that reason.
findings.independence: Same transcript as finding 1, so these are two readings of one document on different lines (payoffs versus one-offs). The Q1 2026 transcript also flagged 'Q2 and Q3 projected payoffs are very high': https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/04/16/home-bancshares-homb-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/

findings.finding: The FOMC raised the funds target 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16. On the Q2 call CFO Tipton said 'if the Fed did move a quarter or a half, I think it is a net positive for us'. With $1.25bn of CDs at mid-3% repricing in H2, the Q4 NIM commentary on the call should lean constructive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no HOMB event with a rate move inside the quarter in the baseline. NIM held at 4.51% in Q1 and Q2 and has not been the line the stock moved on.
findings.why_not_priced: The hike is public, but the stock is -5.2% over 20 days since it, so the market has not credited HOMB with a NIM tailwind. If it had, the stock would sit nearer its 52-week high and sell-side targets ($31-36) would have moved up after September, and none did. This is a macro-to-company link that management confirmed only as a conditional view in July, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Company view: https://allmind.ai/earnings/event/2932329 (2026-07-16). Wells Fargo's Q3 release cites lower deposit costs lifting NII +12% y/y, a large-bank proxy: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000072971/000007297126000318/wfc3qer10-13x26ex991xrelea.htm

findings.finding: Allison committed to buy back the shares issued for Mountain Commerce (about $146m of stock) and said 'if we get an opportunity, we'll be extremely aggressive'. Only ~2.0m shares had been repurchased in H1 ($13.9m in Q1, $40.5m in Q2 at about $27). The stock traded around $27-30 through Q3, so a large Q3 repurchase and a lower share count are likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no separate reaction on record. The Q2 buyback of 1.5m shares came with a +4.78% reaction, alongside the beat.
findings.why_not_priced: Share count is a small EPS lever, and consensus may model only the Q2 pace. With CET1 at 16.4% and the stock 10% off its high, an aggressive Q3 buyback would show up in diluted shares and EPS, and in a stock trading above the ~$27 Q2 buyback price rather than near it ($28.19).
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q gives H1 repurchases of 507,622 + 1,500,000 shares: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1331520/000133152026000112/homb-20260630.htm (filed 2026-08-07). It is a different document from the same company.

findings.finding: Short interest rose from 8.53m to 9.91m shares across the 2026-09-15 and 09-30 settlements (about 5% of shares outstanding, 6 days to cover). Even a clean in-line print has some short-covering fuel.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is a mechanism and not a fact the price absorbs. At 5% of shares it is not crowded, so it is sized at +0.1.

findings.finding: A large non-performing credit of 'a little less than $100 million' was 'still where it was' at Q2. Management said it expects no further loss, but the credit produced no income and there was 'some movement' on it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NPLs fell 8bp in Q2 alongside a +4.78% reaction. No prior HOMB print in the baseline had a credit surprise.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a known item with a two-sided resolution: a payoff would lift interest income and lower NPLs, while a further reserve would cut EPS. The market cannot see which way it went before the release. Sized near zero.
findings.independence: Q2 release: NPLs $185.3m (1.08%), ACL 1.92%, NCOs $5.8m: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001331520/000133152026000106/homb063026earningsrelease.htm. Same transcript as findings 1, 2 and 4.

outside_window.finding: The Mountain Commerce core conversion is set for November 2026. Modelled cost saves are ~20% (~$5.5m a year, about $0.5m a month), landing mostly in Q4 and fully in 2027. Expenses are guided at about $120m a quarter.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR filings since 2026-07-15: no 8-K other than the Q2 2.02. Only a 10-Q, Form 4s, Form 144s and a 13G (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001331520&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40)
No Sept/Oct 2026 news on a new HOMB acquisition or deal announcement
No October 2026 analyst rating or target changes. The latest are July-August raises: Piper $36, Stephens $35, KBW $32, Cantor $31 (https://www.streetinsider.com/rating_history.php?q=HOMB)
No regional-bank sell-off or credit scare in October 2026. The KRE drawdown hits are October 2025.
Centennial Bank litigation and foreclosure searches turned up only immaterial Arkansas cases
Fed H.8 small-bank loan data for September 2026: the series was not retrievable at weekly resolution (https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h8/20261009/)
No regional peer with a Sun Belt footprint like HOMB's has reported Q3 2026 before today

rejected_candidates.candidate: Benzinga headline that Home BancShares 'expects Q3 EPS of 64 cents'
rejected_candidates.detail: Appeared only in a search summary. No dated article or company document was found, and the company does not issue EPS guidance.
The company's own notice of 2026-09-14 sets results after the close on 2026-10-14 (sweep row confirmation_source).

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The findings lean slightly positive against a -5.2% 20-day run-up, a mild cut against the tape. The size is too small for the tension to matter.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar has a single source): the Fed-hike guidance finding was capped from +0.4 to +0.3.
Rule 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the payoff finding was cut from -0.2 to -0.1, because its own text records that management over-delivered on a similar warning in Q2.
Rule 7 / rule 5 (positioning): the short-interest finding was cut from +0.2 to +0.1, because 5% of shares is not a crowded short.
The one-off finding (-0.3), the buyback (+0.3) and the NPL item (-0.1) were left unchanged. abs_move_pct and p_up were unchanged, so expected_move_pct stays +0.11.
